rule: SHADOW records only: a NAMED cell of a family off the 2026-11-18 grandfather roster without a complete six-field EconomicPrior passes gate 1 as PRIOR_INCOMPLETE with its missing fields named. research/economic_prior_backfill.py writes LIVE (PRIOR_INCOMPLETE fails gate 1) when mean - 2 SE > 0 of the forward-clock difference (prior-complete minus prior-incomplete exp_r per clock) over >= 10 clocks a side with >= 10 forward observations each (newest 200 clocks a side), SHADOW when mean + 1 SE < 0, and leaves the mode alone in between. pinned=true freezes the mode; OFF stops the requirement.
